meta.name: COG1-CORE
meta.answer_instruction: Reply with ONLY the final answer on a single line. No explanation, no punctuation, no units unless asked.
meta.note: v0 public core: a basic capability floor (catches broken/junk/mislabeled models), deliberately auto-gradable. Calibration run against known model tiers pending; threshold provisional. The private rotating audit set is NOT in this repo by design (see WHITEPAPER.md §5).
